text: Implementing a HalfFlow-owned canonical AffineMap adapter. The moving-to-fixed entry point will use the canonical operator's exact inverse exactly once, delegate to the existing supplied initializer/midpoint split, and expose the resulting ForwardMidpoint for HalfFlowCc. Shared tests will cover asymmetric physical grids, landmarks, default-delegate parity, and a valid 180-degree affine rejected by the current midpoint square-root algorithm as a typed failure.
